svg.title: Yaketsuku Netsu — Scorch and Steel. Draft 2 / Yaketsuku Netsu classification / forked tree.
svg.desc: 8 skills, 4 purchases, one Advanced Art maximum. Heat in the Steel forks into Searing Edge then Blade That Never Cools, or Fever Pitch then White-Hot Blood. Blistered Guard forks into Heat Finds the Seam then Nothing Left Forbidden. No paths converge. Bonuses affect existing supported tags on Yaketsuku Netsu jutsu (bloodline-keyed classification, proposed extension).

BUFF","adverse":false,"base":100.0,"gain":0,"final":100.0,"calculation":"static","supported":false,"capped_at_100":false}],"advanced_arts":["Nothing Left Forbidden"]}],"narrow_kit_exception":"Eight nodes and three Advanced Arts rather than ten and four: the kit has three supported tags on four rows (Damage x2 on Forgotten Ember Blade and Forbidden Chakra Fury; Increase Damage Given x1 on Ember Blade; Increase Damage Taken x1 on Chakra Fury); Chakra Shield's absorb and shield are not potency targets. Universal opener accepted as a design choice, not a four-row impossibility: Heat in the Steel is in all 8 legal full builds because Blistered Guard has one child. A leaf Hidden Art under Blistered Guard was enumerated and rejected as filler, since the kit has no fourth role: +1 Damage/+1 IDG leaves 06,07,08,09 (Damage +2, IDG +1, IDT +8) dominated by 01,06,07,08 (+2/+2/+8), so the opener stays in every non-dominated build; +1 Damage/+2 IDG copies Heat in the Steel; +2 Damage or +3 IDG twin Searing Edge or Fever Pitch (11 of 12 builds non-dominated); any IDT flat lifts the exposure maximum above +8. The +2 Damage leaf remains an open user decision (design notes).","design_notes":["Node split: 2 Foundations, 3 Hidden Arts, 3 Advanced Arts, each Advanced Art 3 BP deep, so any two cost 5+. Heat in the Steel (Damage +1, IDG +2; 3 of 4 rows) forks into Searing Edge \u2192 Blade That Never Cools (Damage +2/+3) and Fever Pitch \u2192 White-Hot Blood (IDG +3/+5); Blistered Guard \u2192 Heat Finds the Seam \u2192 Nothing Left Forbidden (IDT +2/+3/+3, capstone Damage +1) is one chain. Reference reuse: the Damage pair copies Crown of Cinders/Solar Cataclysm (+2/+3) verbatim; departures below.","Flats by coverage: Damage reaches 2 rows, route +6 (40\u219246), at the guardrail. The heat chain borrows the 2+3+5 = +10 shape of Taiyo Kami's DDT chain (a defensive self buff); Taiyo Kami's own IDG peaks at +5 over two rows (row-weighted 10), while this +10 sits on one offensive row lifting every element-less hit. Density: strongest full build 17 on 4 rows (01,02,03,04) vs Taiyo Kami 31 on 9 (13.8 pro rata) and Lycanthropy 20 on 5, the densest per row. IDT 2+3+3 = +8, one over Taiyo Kami's +7.","Blistered Guard (IDT +2, row-weighted 2, lowest-value node) is a deliberate single-tag Foundation, departing from Taiyo Kami's two-tag Foundations (Dawnheart IDG/IDT, Sunward Oath DDT/DDG) because the guardrails forbid a secondary: +1 Damage would put 01,02,03,06 at Damage +7, +1 IDG would put 01,04,05,06 at IDG +11. Burst and Heat examples take it fourth, so each is the lower row-weighted variant (16 vs 17; 14 vs 16), still non-dominated; Fever Pitch and Searing Edge are the named alternatives.","Interactions (\u00a73, \u00a73b): Ember Blade's heat row is Bukijutsu-filtered but element-less, so the filter is not binding: it matches every element-less hit of any stat type plus Bukijutsu elemental hits. Chakra Fury's exposure lists four stat types, no element: every non-pierce hit. Both add power/100 \u00d7 the staged base and never touch pierce; only the Bukijutsu IDG passive (22 + 0.15/level, fromType bloodline) multiplies. Same-tag effects all stack and add (process.ts 1109\u20131117).","Timing (\u00a73b, \u00a74b): both attacks are OTHER_USER single-target, range 4, 60 AP, cooldowns 6 and 7. Heat is SELF, realized on the caster at cast; exposure lands on the struck target. Neither acts in its cast round; each is live the 2 rounds after, so the second attack of a back-to-back pair (either order) gets the first one's window. The next round holds both windows, but both attacks are on cooldown, so only weapons, basic attacks, other jutsu and allies use it. The Damage route needs no window.","Allocations: 8 legal full builds, all non-dominated, 3 with no Advanced Art (01,02,04,06 attacks 43/heat 35%/exposure 32%; 01,02,06,07 43/32%/35%; 01,04,06,07 41/35%/35%). Fourth purchases: Burst \u2192 Blistered Guard or Fever Pitch; Heat \u2192 Blistered Guard or Searing Edge; Exposure \u2192 Heat in the Steel. Open user choices: a +2 Damage leaf under Blistered Guard ends the universal opener (adds 06,07,08,09: Damage +3, IDT +8; maxima unchanged; 11 of 12 non-dominated); heat +10 or +8; exposure +8 or +7."],"risks":["Classification: no row carries an element, so the tree needs the proposed bloodline-keyed label (Yaketsuku Netsu). Under the current resolver a None selector matches all 4 rows by fallback and also every element-less supported row in all 44 kit dossiers, plus non-elemental jutsu the player casts (35 census bloodlines list None as an explicit element). Normal-jutsu collisions are unverified.","Heat breadth (user-owned value): White-Hot Blood puts Ember Blade's self IDG at 40% for the 2 rounds after each cast on every element-less non-pierce hit, beside the multiplicative Bukijutsu IDG passive (22 + 0.15/level) and summing with main-tree or gear IDG. Taiyo Kami's IDG reference is +5 over two rows, not +10 on one; density 17/4 vs 31/9 and Lycanthropy 20/5. +8 (2+3+3) is the fallback.","Exposure breadth: Nothing Left Forbidden puts Chakra Fury's Increase Damage Taken at 38% for the 2 rounds after the cast; four stat types, no element, so every non-pierce hit from allies, weapons and normal jutsu gains it, and two Yaketsuku Netsu casters' exposures on one target add (76%). Value scales with ally output; held to +8 for that reason, +7 (2+2+3) matches Taiyo Kami's IDT ceiling.","Universal opener (accepted, visible to the user): Heat in the Steel is in all 8 legal full builds (6 of 8 also hold Blistered Guard), against brief \u00a71's aim of no mandatory opener. It is a layout choice, not a four-row impossibility: a +2 Damage leaf under Blistered Guard would remove it at the cost of a Searing Edge twin. The enumerated leaf shapes are in narrow_kit_exception.","Damage is formula-calculated (sqrt stat scaling: Ember Blade on Bukijutsu / Speed, Strength; Chakra Fury on Highest), then multiplied by the Bukijutsu IDG passive; heat or exposure from an earlier round adds power/100 \u00d7 the staged base. +6 raw power is not linear +6 damage; realized value depends on stats. No combat simulation.","Unsupported rows and modes: Chakra Shield's absorb 30% and shield 100 receive nothing, so the tree cannot serve the kit's defence; the 5% reflect passive and the Ninjutsu-filtered Increase Damage Taken passive on the bearer are not jutsu rows. Skill-tree and bloodline effects are skipped in ranked PvP / sparring at the pin.","Targeting and uptime: each attack needs a living non-caster user in range 4. Ember Blade aimed at an ally withholds its ENEMIES-only damage row but still realizes the SELF heat on the caster; Chakra Fury on an ally lands its damage and exposure (friendly fire none). Heat and exposure are 2-round windows per 6- and 7-round cooldowns. Realization when the hit misses or is prevented was not verified."],"progression":{"currency":"Bloodright Point","abbreviation":"BP","acquired_with":"silver","acquisition_cap":4,"node_cost":1,"silver_price":null,"ownership_gate":"current bloodline","separate_from_normal_skill_points":true},"evaluation_level":25,"game_source_pin":"16498fd776fad9c91e4b84efed4380fe3a487050","snapshot":{"public_kit_snapshot":"2026-10-01T14:58:45.422376+00:00","hidden_kit_snapshot":"2026-09-30"},"audit":{"available_skills":8,"foundation_count":2,"hidden_art_count":3,"advanced_art_count":3,"bloodright_point_cap":4,"cost_per_skill":1,"maximum_advanced_arts":1,"minimum_two_advanced_cost":5,"maximum_parents_per_node":1,"maximum_depth":3,"legal_allocations_by_size":{"0":1,"1":2,"2":4,"3":7,"4":8},"full_budget_allocations":8,"non_dominated_full_allocations":8,"all_nodes_in_non_dominated_builds":true,"nodes_absent_from_non_dominated_builds":[],"maximum_tag_bonuses":{"damage":6,"increasedamagegiven":10,"increasedamagetaken":8},"supported_rows_in_kit":4,"supported_rows_by_tag":{"damage":2,"increasedamagegiven":1,"increasedamagetaken":1},"tags_targeted_by_tree":["damage","increasedamagegiven","increasedamagetaken"],"supported_tags_in_kit_not_targeted":[],"revision":"Draft 2 / Yaketsuku Netsu classification / forked tree","source_snapshot":"2026-10-01T14:58:45.422376+00:00","limits":["Proposed potency classification behavior; not implemented or verified in the live engine.","All existing supported tags of Yaketsuku Netsu jutsu inherit Yaketsuku Netsu potency eligibility; original combat elements and target scopes stay intact.","Every matching row on a jutsu receives each matching modifier; repeated rows are counted separately.","Damage values are raw power, not final-damage percentages; percentage-valued tags are capped at 100.","Afterburn is an enemy debuff: for its existing duration, damage the target takes causes extra Afterburn damage at its percentage (60% cap per hit). It is not itself a damage instance; downstream instances were not simulated.","Unsupported tags (e.g. wound, shield, stun, pierce, absorb, poison, drain, summon) receive no bonuses.","No combat simulation. Budget and numerical non-dominance checks do not establish equal combat strength.","Main-tree effects, bloodline passives, equipment, AP, uptime and modifier delivery are outside this audit."]},"legal_full_budget_builds":[{"ids":["01","02","03","04"],"bonuses":{"damage":6,"increasedamagegiven":5}},{"ids":["01","02","03","06"],"bonuses":{"damage":6,"increasedamagegiven":2,"increasedamagetaken":2}},{"ids":["01","02","04","05"],"bonuses":{"damage":3,"increasedamagegiven":10}},{"ids":["01","02","04","06"],"bonuses":{"damage":3,"increasedamagegiven":5,"increasedamagetaken":2}},{"ids":["01","02","06","07"],"bonuses":{"damage":3,"increasedamagegiven":2,"increasedamagetaken":5}},{"ids":["01","04","05","06"],"bonuses":{"damage":1,"increasedamagegiven":10,"increasedamagetaken":2}},{"ids":["01","04","06","07"],"bonuses":{"damage":1,"increasedamagegiven":5,"increasedamagetaken":5}},{"ids":["01","06","07","08"],"bonuses":{"damage":2,"increasedamagegiven":2,"increasedamagetaken":8}}]}

g.text: Draft 2 / Yaketsuku Netsu classification / forked tree · Foundations support. Hidden Arts focus. Advanced Arts define.
1 BP each · Acquire points with silver
Every Yaketsuku Netsu jutsu: existing supported tags qualify; combat scope stays unchanged.
Finish a path in 3 purchases. Spend your fourth on support or a sibling Hidden Art.
Any two Advanced Arts require at least 5 points. Your limit is 4.
Each skill purchased once · Only your current bloodline unlocks · No converging paths
Examples are choices, not locked presets. Advanced Arts are optional.
Blade That Never Cools path + Blistered Guard
Nothing Left Forbidden path + Heat in the Steel
IDG: Increase Damage Given · IDT: Increase Damage Taken
Jutsu level 25 · main-tree bonuses and bloodline passives excluded
Static bonuses: a 35% tag with +5% becomes 40%. A 40 EP jutsu with +5 Damage becomes 45EP.
Proposed whole-kit potency classification. Current effect-element matching alone does not provide this inheritance.
8 legal four-skill allocations · 3 Advanced Arts available · Combat tuning remains experimental
